testimonials.content: When my husband suffered severe chest pain at midnight, Chitwan Sajha Hospital’s Emergency & Cath Lab team performed emergency angioplasty within 30 minutes. We are deeply grateful to Dr. Ramesh and the nursing staff for saving his life.

I flew to Chitwan Nepal for my knee replacement. The hospital facilities, robotic accuracy, private room luxury, and post-op care rivaled top hospitals in Australia at one-third of the cost. Fantastic experience!
